[[Purifier Krewe Member]]s are [[Asura]] who offer the [[Asuran Bodyguard]] blessing. They can be found next to [[resurrection shrine]]s.

==Locations==
* [[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Trial of Zinn}}
** {{NPC location|Verdant Cascades}}

==Dialogue==
'''Offered by shrines near portals
: ''"Gracious, you startled me! I was looking over the plans for a scent-cleaning air-o-matic. We Asura have very sensitive noses. It's hard to work here what with all the smells from these monsters. Why don't you give us a hand and get rid of them and their stench? I'll even give you a little something to help in that task. Do you agree?"''

:: [[File:Asuran Bodyguard.jpg|20px]] ''"Sure, I was going to do that anyway!"''
:: {{no|ingame}} ''"I don't work with anyone shorter than my kneecaps."''
:: '''When asked again:''' ''"You'd never notice, but the Asura have an amazing sense of smell. We can navigate by our noses in the darkest caverns. We usually end up finding where we're going, or walking in circles until we've finished lunch."''

'''Offered by shrines further into the zone'''
: ''"Have you heard? Our krewe is making a scent-cleaning air-o-matic to help with this horrible stench. What do you mean, "What stench?" Monsters, of course! And unwashed bookahs. If you could kill a lot of those monsters, we could start to attune the components we already have. Do it, and I'll even provide a little advantage to assist you!"''
:: [[File:Veteran Asuran Bodyguard.jpg|20px]] ''"Smells like...actually, I don't know WHAT that smells like."''
:: {{no|ingame}} ''"I need to go take a bath. Phew."''
:: '''When asked again:''' ''"You'd never notice, but the Asura have an amazing sense of smell. We can navigate by our noses in the darkest caverns. We usually end up finding where we're going, or walking in circles until we've finished lunch."''

;Not under [[Veteran Asuran Bodyguard]]
: ''"Many of my colleagues said you'd never do it, but I know how to pick 'em. I knew you were every bit as brave and bold as I told them you were!"''

:: [[File:Veteran Asuran Bodyguard.jpg|20px]] ''"Smells like...actually, I don't know WHAT that smells like."''
:: {{no|ingame}} ''"I need to go take a bath. Phew."''
:: '''When asked again:''' ''"Many of my colleagues said you'd never do it, but I know how to pick 'em. I knew you were every bit as brave and bold as I told them you were!"''

;Under Asuran Bodyguard
:Less than 25 kills:
::: ''"Hmm. (0..24) kills?  Come back when you've got a few more."''
[[Category:Offers Eye of the North bounty-like blessing]]

;During Trial of Zinn, before the trial
:''"So much tension and scheming among the geniuses. Hopefully this trial will give them a chance to clear the air. That’s a joke. I’m part of the “Purifier” Krewe. You can laugh."''

;After the trial
:''"At first I was happy no violence broke out. Then I was a little disappointed. Then I considered the probability that I might have been caught in the crossfire. I'm back to being happy now."''
